messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: 7L7OpgyFpurW-daEsukQ5A

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "7L7OpgyFpurW-daEsukQ5A"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map of the ruined city at dusk.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept ridge overlooking a half-collapsed royal city, torn banners flapping in the distance; an ink-stained coat flutters as a brass compass spins.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of false invitations ahead.
scenes.visual_description: An oil lamp held aloft, one glowing eye burning inside its flame, casting orange light over the cracked road into the city.

scenes.caption: The tin fox scouts the outer castle gate.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes crouched beneath an iron portcullis, key-wind tail ticking softly in the moonlight.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver arrives by swimming through a tall window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges shoulders-first from a vertical pane of glass set in a ruined wall, coat shimmering with reflected city lanterns.

scenes.caption: The team gathers in a collapsed market square.
scenes.visual_description: Broken stalls and overturned carts under a violet sky; a mapmaker, a clockwork fox, a helmeted diver, and a glowing lamp stand together in a tight circle.

scenes.caption: A cursed tower glows red, tempting them off course.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning spire pulses with crimson light, runes crawling up its stones; the lamp's eye narrows in distrust.

scenes.caption: They slip past an armored patrol along the wall.
scenes.visual_description: Steel-plated figures march in lockstep along a parapet above; below, the tin fox and the diver press into a shadowed alcove of ivy and rubble.

scenes.caption: Frightened townsfolk whisper of a great winged beast.
scenes.visual_description: Hooded figures peer from boarded windows, pointing skyward at a torn royal banner shaped like a serpent; Mara writes notes by lamp-light.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks a checkpoint.
scenes.visual_description: A plump official slumped over a ledger pillow, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, snoring beneath a striped boom gate.

scenes.caption: Tin fox lifts the official's keys without waking him.
scenes.visual_description: A delicate metal paw hooks a brass ring of keys from a snoring sleeve; the lamp dims its eye to hide the glow.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver dives through a stained window into the keep.
scenes.visual_description: A rippling stained-glass rose distorts as the diver plunges through it like water, coat trailing colored reflections inside a torchlit hall.

scenes.caption: A magic door demands a true name to open.
scenes.visual_description: A black iron door inlaid with shifting silver letters; Mara holds her compass to the lock while the lamp leans close, eye flaring.

scenes.caption: Inside, they find the captive bound in mirror chains.
scenes.visual_description: A dim chamber where a slender figure is wrapped in chains made of jointed mirror shards; the diver reaches in through one of the panes.

scenes.caption: Tin fox triggers an alarm chain by accident.
scenes.visual_description: A clockwork paw catches a tripwire; brass bells cascade down the corridor while blue glass eyes go wide.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols flood the inner courtyard.
scenes.visual_description: Plumed helmets and polearms pour through arches into a moonlit courtyard; the lamp swings violently as Mara sprints, ledger pages flying.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver opens an escape through a fountain pool.
scenes.visual_description: A round fountain glows like a mirror; the diver stands waist-deep, holding out a gloved hand as reflections swirl into a tunnel of light.

scenes.caption: They race across the river bridge at dawn.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge under pink sky, half its arches crumbling into the river; four figures sprint past torn royal banners snapping in the wind.

scenes.caption: On the far bank, Mara marks the ruined city closed.
scenes.visual_description: A misty hill beyond the bridge; the mapmaker draws a thick ink line across the city on her map while the lamp's eye softens to gold and the tin fox curls at her boots.
